entry.title: London King's Cross railway station

groundCutout.basis: The inspected aerial picture identifies the western semicircular concourse beside the long train sheds. Standard viewer PMTiles retains a combined building envelope approximately164m across and256m long; source bounds are165.4x250.1m. Retained heading places native+Z at the southern clock facade and the concourse to the west. Working PMTiles datum16.271386566468557m sets approximate floor contact. A bounded inset opening only under the authored covered floor avoids coarse urban terrain through platforms/concourse; surrounding raw PMTiles remain. Member footprints, exact entry thresholds and signed bearing are approximate visualization, not surveys.
